name: rank-in-maps
description: Portable Rank-in-Maps skills and MCP access for evidence-grounded local SEO workflows.

interface.longDescription: Rank-in-Maps: Local SEO help from your saved audit data. Connect your Rank-in-Maps account and choose one of your businesses. See what your saved audits found, get clear next steps for your local SEO, and save drafts to your RIM workspace. Build an OKF Business Second Brain: your business facts, goals and knowledge, organised for your AI. Packaged skills can create business files in a folder you choose when your AI has access to it. Missing or out-of-date evidence stays explicit. Nothing goes live on your Google Business Profile without your approval, and connecting the plugin does not publish anything. Available actions depend on your RIM plan and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Start with Rank-in-Maps and show the next step for my account.
Explain my saved audit findings and the most useful next actions.
Read my saved business facts and show what is confirmed or still unknown.
